cities.limitation: Native pre-rendered groups, lower floors win where projections overlap; surface ruins excluded in Undercity. Enclosed transparent rock gaps use a dark native-color backing, not new walkable space.

repair_limit: Only detected uniform land cells: material/height detail with nearby color normalization. Inferred transition scenery is not surveyed geography; no roads/buildings/POIs are fabricated.

join_audit.limit: Numeric audit of every adjacent in-scope ADT seam. Natural biome/coast changes are preserved; this does not certify visual correctness in game.
